raw.company_name: Seniovo GmbH - Ein Unternehmen der HORNBACH-Gruppe
raw.title: Junior Full Stack Developer (All Genders)
raw.description:
Deine Aufgaben

  • Pflege, Konfiguration und Erweiterung unserer operativen Systeme (ZohoCRM, Desk, Books, Signund angrenzende Tools)
  • Entwicklung von Automationen und Business-Logik mit Deluge, Python und JavaScript: Workflows, Functions, Client-Skripte und geplante Jobs
  • Entwicklung und Verbesserung LLM-gestützter Lösungen: Du baust KI-Agenten und Automationen auf Basis von Large Language Models, entwickelst und testest Prompts, pflegst die zugrunde liegenden Wissensbasen und Trainingsdaten und misst systematisch, ob die Ergebnisse besser werden
  • Design und Implementierung von Datenaustausch zwischen Systemen via REST-APIs, Webhooks und Automationsplattformen
  • Debugging von Integrationen und Behebung von Data-Quality-Issues: Logs lesen, API-Calls nachverfolgen, Ursachen finden und sauber beheben
  • Unterstützung interner Stakeholder: Prozessanforderungen in funktionierende, wartbare Lösungen übersetzen
  • Dokumentation deiner Lösungen, damit sie für andere und dich selbst nachvollziehbar bleiben
  • Mitarbeit an Frontend-/UI-Themen im Rahmen der CRM-Oberfläche


Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium (oder kurz vor Abschluss) in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, einer technischen Fachrichtung oder vergleichbar
  • Interesse an KI- und LLM-Themen und Lust, damit praktisch zu arbeiten
  • Solide Grundlagen in mindestens einer Skriptsprache (z. B. JavaScript oder Python) 
  • Verständnis dafür, wie REST-APIs funktionieren: HTTP-Methoden, Statuscodes, JSON, Authentifizierung (z. B. API-Keys, OAuth2-Grundlagen)
  • Grundkenntnisse relationaler Datenmodelle und wie Geschäftsdaten strukturiert sind
  • Strukturierte, analytische Arbeitsweise mit echtem Blick fürs Detail
  • Hohe Lernbereitschaft, Neugier und Agilität bei Veränderungen
  • Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Offenheit, früh Fragen zu stellen
  • Deutschkenntnisse mindestens B2-Niveau
  • Nice to have: Erfahrung mit Zoho-Produkten (CRM, Desk, Books, Creator, Flow), Low-Code-Tools (Make,Zapier, n8n),Git, SQL oder SSO-Konzepten


Warum wir?

  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit: Du ermöglichst barrierefreies Wohnen für Menschen mit eingeschränkter Mobilität – und leistest so jeden Tag einen echten gesellschaftlichen Beitrag
  • Echter Teamgeist: Wir arbeiten nicht nur zusammen, wir halten zusammen. Dich erwartet ein offenes, unterstützendes Team auf Augenhöhe
  • Mobilität & Benefits: Wähle flexibel zwischen dem Deutschlandticket, einem JobRad (nach der Probezeit) oder einer Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft
  • Flexibilität: Nutze nach der Probezeit die Möglichkeit zur Workation von anderen Orten aus
  • Mehr als nur Gehalt: Profitiere von attraktiven Corporate Benefits und unserem freiwilligen HORNBACH-Mitarbeiteraktienprogramm
  • Wohlfühl-Office: Dich erwartet ein modernes Büro mit kostenlosen Snacks und Getränken, einer großen Küche und regelmäßigen Team-Events

title: Werkstudent Go-To-Market & Partner Management (m/w/d)
description: Deine Mission Das Produkt steht. Jetzt entscheidet sich, wie wir darüber sprechen. Das ist kein Callcenter-Job. Keine Kaltakquise, keine gekaufte Liste, keine Quote pro Stunde. Du kontaktierst Betriebe, die uns bereits kennen. Installationspartner, mit denen wir seit Monaten oder Jahren arbeiten. Sie wissen, wer Bees & Bears ist — sie wissen nur noch nicht, was wir gerade Neues für sie gebaut haben. Warum es diese Stelle gibt: Wir bringen ein neues Produkt an den Start, das unseren Partnerbetrieben einen konkreten Engpass löst. Technisch ist es fertig. Was jetzt zählt, ist die Einführung — und die passiert nicht über eine Mail. Sie passiert in Gesprächen. Deine Aufgabe: Diese Gespräche führen. Du bekommst eine Einarbeitung und einen Gesprächsleitfaden. Nach acht Wochen sollte auch dieser Leitfaden noch besser sein, weil du hundert Gespräche geführt hast. Wer nur die Liste abarbeiten will, ist hier falsch. Wer wartet, bis jemand den nächsten Schritt vorgibt, auch. Wohin die Rolle wächst: Sie startet fokussiert: ein Produkt, ein definierter Partnerkreis, ein Gespräch nach dem anderen. Sie ist aber nicht als Telefonjob angelegt, sondern als Einstieg ins Partner Management — eigene Partner, Ende zu Ende, von Erstkontakt bis laufender Betreuung. Wie schnell das geht, hängt an dir, nicht an einem Kalender. Konkret: ANRUFEN, NICHT ABTELEFONIEREN: Du stellst das neue Produkt bei Bestandspartnern vor. Nicht Skript vom Blatt, sondern ein Gespräch, das beim Gegenüber ankommt. DEN PITCH WEITERENTWICKELN: Du merkst, welcher Einstieg funktioniert und welcher Einwand immer wieder kommt. Du behältst das nicht für dich, du änderst den Leitfaden. ZUHÖREN UND ZURÜCKSPIELEN: Was Partner am Telefon sagen, ist die ehrlichste Rückmeldung, die wir zum Produkt bekommen. Du bist die direkteste Leitung dorthin und nutzt sie. BEZIEHUNG STATT KONTAKTLISTE: Du übernimmst einen festen Kreis von Partnern. Nach drei Monaten kennen die deinen Namen, nicht unsere Rufnummer. SAUBER NACHHALTEN: Was besprochen wurde, landet nachvollziehbar in Hubspot, damit das Team damit weiterarbeiten kann. Dein Talent SUSTAINABILITY: Du interessierst dich sehr für Klimaschutz und Nachhaltigkeit und willst mehr darüber lernen und bewegen WORKING STUDENT: Du befindest dich aktuell in einem Studium und bringst idealerweise erste praktische Erfahrungen mit, zum Beispiel durch Praktika oder ehrenamtliches Engagement AM TELEFON ZU HAUSE: Du hast schon mal jemanden am Telefon von etwas überzeugt — im Job, im Verein, im Nebenjob, egal. AUF DEN PUNKT, OHNE KALT ZU WIRKEN: Du sagst in drei Sätzen, wofür andere zehn brauchen, und klingst dabei trotzdem wie ein Mensch. Handwerksbetriebe haben keine Zeit für Marketing-Sprache und merken sofort, wenn jemand welche spricht. ZUVERLÄSSIG, NICHT VERHANDELBAR: Zugesagter Rückruf am Donnerstag heißt Donnerstag. Das ist bei uns Grundvoraussetzung, keine Stärke. DU BRINGST WAS ZURÜCK: Nach fünfzig Gesprächen hast du eine Meinung dazu, was funktioniert. Du sagst sie, ohne dass wir danach fragen müssen. DEUTSCH AUF MUTTERSPRACHNIVEAU: Unsere Partner sind deutsche Handwerksbetriebe. Das Gespräch läuft auf Deutsch, inklusive Zwischentöne und Dialekt am anderen Ende. MINDESTENS 6 MONATE ZEIT: Kürzer lohnt sich für keinen von uns beiden. Bis du richtig gut in diesen Gesprächen bist, vergehen Wochen. Unser Angebot Wachstum & Kultur Werde Teil eines Teams, das nicht nur fachlich durchstartet, sondern aktiv eine gesunde und nachhaltige Unternehmenskultur lebt. Bei uns zählt das Miteinander genauso viel wie der Erfolg. Impact & Awareness Deine Stimme hat Gewicht, im Büro und darüber hinaus. Neben deinem regulären Urlaub bekommst du zusätzliche freie Tage für Klimaaktivismus, Demos oder Projekte, die dir am Herzen liegen. Flexibilität & Vertrauen Gestalte deinen Arbeitsalltag nach deinem Rhythmus. Nutze unsere Flexdays, um mobil zu arbeiten – egal ob von zu Hause oder unterwegs innerhalb Deutschlands, immer in Absprache mit deinem Team. Extra Benefits für dich Wir machen deinen Alltag einfacher: Du bekommst einen flexiblen Bonus, den du nach Lust und Laune für Dinge einsetzen kannst, die dir Freude machen – ob Fitness, Kultur oder kleine Extras. Verpflegung & Wohlbefinden Wenn der Arbeitstag mal länger wird, sorgen wir dafür, dass niemand hungrig bleibt. Bestell dir über Wolt eine Mahlzeit direkt ins Büro – easy und lecker. Community & Spirit Wir verändern die Welt – und verlieren dabei nie den Spaß. Freu dich auf regelmäßige Offsites, Teamabende und unser legendäres „Bees & Beers“ als perfekten Ausgleich zu unserer Mission. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Performance Creative Strategist - Social & Paid (w/m/d)
description: Was du bei uns machen wirst: Wie bringt man Menschen dazu, sich freiwillig mit ihrer Steuererklärung zu beschäftigen? Genau das ist deine Aufgabe. Als Performance Creative Strategist bei Zasta entwickelst du Ideen, Hooks und Kampagnen, die aus einem komplexen Finanzthema relevante und unterhaltsame Werbung machen – und gleichzeitig messbar performen. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Paid Social, insbesondere Meta und TikTok. Gleichzeitig hast du die Möglichkeit, erfolgreiche Social-First-Ansätze auf TV zu übertragen und den Kanal gemeinsam mit uns neu zu denken. Dabei bekommst du viel konzeptionellen Freiraum: Du entwickelst neue Creative Angles, hinterfragst bestehende Ansätze und findest über Daten, Zielgruppen-Insights und Testing heraus, welche Botschaften wirklich funktionieren. Zielgruppen wirklich verstehen : Du analysierst Zielgruppen, ihre Bedürfnisse und ihre Mediennutzung. Du weißt, wie sich Botschaften je nach Kanal und Funnel-Stufe unterscheiden müssen – und setzt genau dort an. Brücke zwischen Data & Kreativität sein : Du arbeitest eng mit Performance-Marketing, Data & Kreativ-Agenturen zur Ableitung und Optimierung von Creatives anhand von KPIs zusammen und übersetzt das in neue kreative Ansätze. TV neu denken : Du hast Lust, TV nicht als verstaubten Kanal zu sehen, sondern als Spielfeld für starke, moderne Markenkommunikation, die klare Performance bringt. Du bringst frische Ideen ein und denkst TV konsequent aus der Social-Logik heraus. Testing & Learnings vorantreiben : Du denkst in Iterationen, entwickelst Testing-Frameworks für Creatives und sorgst dafür, dass Learnings systematisch zurück in neue Konzepte fließen. Was du idealerweise mitbringst: Du hast fundierte Erfahrungen im Bereich Creative Strategy, Creative Conception, Art Direction oder Kampagnenentwicklung. I dealerweise warst du vorher in einem digitalen Performance-Umfeld tätig. Du bringst ein t iefes Verständnis für den Bereich Paid Social (z.B. Meta, TikTok) mit und hast Interesse oder erste Erfahrungen im TV-Umfeld. Du zeigst ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für leadorientierte Performance-Kampagnen und ein Gespür für Zielgruppenpsychologie- du kannst Insights, Daten und Business-Ziele in klare kreative Strategien übersetzen. Du bist neugierig, probierst Dinge aus und hast Lust, Konventionen zu hinterfragen. Du denkst nicht nur in Slides, sondern auch in konkreten Umsetzungen und setzt Ideen proaktiv um. Für die interne und externe Kommunikation sprichst du Deutsch auf C1-Level und bist sicher in der Nutzung gängiger englischer Marketing- und Strategy-Begriffe. Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau Was wir dir bieten: Wir sind ein profitables Unternehmen, das nachhaltig wächst. Unser Management kennt jeden, der bei uns arbeitet. Mit Büros in Rostock und Berlin kannst du frische Seeluft schnuppern oder dich vom Großstadtdschungel mitreißen lassen. Regelmäßige Besuche und Team-Events sorgen für das Gemeinschaftsgefühl. Je nach Standort treffen wir uns an zwei Tagen die Woche vor Ort im Büro - dienstags und mittwochs in Rostock und mittwochs und donnerstags in Berlin. Die restlichen Tage kannst du dir aussuchen, von wo aus du arbeitest. Falls du an den Präsenztagen mal nicht ins Büro kommen kannst, gibt es Jokertage, die du flexibel einsetzen kannst. Tapetenwechsel inklusive - bei Zasta hast du 30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr und die Möglichkeit, bis zu 4 Wochen am Stück innerhalb Europas zu arbeiten. Du bist dir nicht sicher, ob du alle Anforderungen für diese Stelle erfüllst? Wir freuen uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung. Vielleicht bringst du etwas Besonderes in das Team ein, das wir bisher nicht in Betracht gezogen haben. Dein Kontakt bei Zasta: Wenn du Fragen zur Stelle hast, kannst du uns jederzeit über schreiben. Bewerbungen können wir nur online über die Plattform akzeptieren und werden auf anderem Wege nicht beachtet . Wir freuen uns, von dir zu lesen! title: WHOLESALE DIRECTOR EMEA & APAC (Maternity Leave Cover)
description:
ANINE BING is looking for a Wholesale Director EMEA & APAC to join our Wholesale team based in Paris, covering a maternity leave.

This is a fixed-term contract (CDD), starting early December 2026 for the duration of the absence of the employee being replaced — expected to run through approximately May 2027, with the exact end date depending on the return of the employee on leave. A structured handover is planned in two steps: an initial transition with the outgoing Director around mid-December 2026, and a second handover at the end of the assignment, around her return in May 2027.

As a key contributor within our Paris HQ team, the Wholesale Director EMEA & APAC steps into an existing commercial organization and ensures continuity of leadership for our EMEA & APAC wholesale business during the interim period. The role directly manages a team of four — two Wholesale Managers EU + ME/APAC, one ADV Manager EU, and one Wholesale Support Intern — and owns the commercial and operational performance of a multi-market portfolio operated through key accounts, agents, and franchise partners. The role also works closely with our Wholesale Strategic Advisor, an internal resource who supports continuity throughout the assignment.

This is a hybrid position based at our Paris HQ, with a preference for in-person work. The role reports to the CEO.

Responsibilities Include:

  • Provide day-to-day leadership to the two Wholesale Managers EU + ME/APAC, the ADV Manager EU, and the Wholesale Support Intern, ensuring business continuity and uninterrupted decision-making during the interim period
  • Own the commercial performance of the ME & APAC wholesale portfolio — sell-in, sell-through, forecasting, and seasonal budgets across key accounts, agents, distributors, and franchise partners
  • Lead sell-in for any Paris showroom season(s) falling within the contract period: oversee collection presentation, negotiation, seasonal budgets, and payment terms with senior buyers
  • Oversee the network of agents, distributors, and franchise / shop-in-shop partners across ME and APAC: targets, seasonal action plans, brand standards, and performance reviews
  • Ensure ADV operational execution through the ADV Manager: order management, Key Account shipping compliance, 3PL coordination, and delivery / stocklist reporting
  • Act as the primary escalation point for key accounts and priority partners in EMEA & APAC for the duration of the assignment
  • Partner closely with the Wholesale Strategic Advisor to ensure continuity on ongoing initiatives and institutional knowledge throughout the assignment
  • Report portfolio performance directly to the CEO — sell-in/sell-out KPIs, budget vs. actuals, stock and delivery status
  • Coordinate cross-functionally with Merchandising, Production, Operations, and Finance to secure deliveries and resolve escalations
  • Maintain continuity on any in-flight strategic initiatives (including agent-to-direct market transitions) without introducing new strategic shifts absent CEO sign-off
  • Complete a structured handover with the outgoing Director in mid-December 2026, and prepare a full handover back to her ahead of her return around May 2027

Requirements:

  • 8+ years of experience in fashion wholesale, including proven experience managing a commercial team across an international, multi-market portfolio
  • Strong track record as Wholesale Director, Area Manager, or senior Wholesale Manager, with solid knowledge of EMEA markets; working familiarity with APAC market dynamics is expected, as the region is operated through agents and distributors rather than direct management
  • Hands-on experience managing agents, distributors, franchise / master-franchise partners, and key accounts
  • Strong command of sell-in / sell-out analysis, OTB logic, forecasting, and in-season performance management
  • Experience overseeing a Sales Administration / Order Management function (ERP, 3PL coordination, key account portal compliance)
  • Proficiency with B2B and ERP tools (JOOR, NuOrder, Cegid Orli, NetSuite or equivalent) and advanced Excel
  • Fluent English and French required
  • A confident, autonomous people manager, comfortable stepping into an existing team and reporting directly to executive leadership with minimal ramp-up time
  • Available for a fixed-term assignment in Paris starting early December 2026, for the duration of the maternity leave

Benefits & Perks

  • At ANINE BING Paris, we combine creative ambition with a people-first culture. Expect generous time off (including RTT), flexible work, exclusive discounts on our collections, and private sales access — so you can live the brand as much as you build it.
  • Style Perks: Enjoy a generous employee discount and seasonal wardrobe allotments — so you can live the brand, not just represent it.

Base salary: commensurate with profile and experience.

Working at ANINE BING

ANINE BING seeks to empower its employees by providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. Diversity and inclusion is critical to our success as a global brand, and we seek to recruit, develop, and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool.

More about ANINE BING

ANINE BING is a Los Angeles-based fashion house founded in 2012 that blends elements of Scandinavian simplicity with American energy to offer modern wardrobe essentials for women seeking a timeless yet rebellious approach to everyday style. Since its launch, ANINE BING has evolved into a global brand, available in over 90 countries with a growing network of brick-and-mortar retail stores in key cities worldwide.

Powered by a global team of over 250 employees, ANINE BING is headquartered in Los Angeles and Paris, with additional offices in New York and Shanghai.

About Our Paris HQ

Located just off the Champs-Élysées, our Paris headquarters at 1 Rue François 1er is a cornerstone of our international growth. As the home of our Product teams and other key functions, this space reflects our commitment to creativity, collaboration, and global perspective. As we continue to grow across Europe, our Paris office plays a central role in shaping the future of our brand.

raw.title: Finance Business Partner
raw.description:
About Everfield

Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe's software ecosystem.

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices, while focusing on what they do best - building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics. Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 9 countries, and growing.

About the Role

This is not a reporting role. It's ownership of the financial engine for a portfolio of growing software businesses.

You'll be accountable end-to-end for the accounting integrity of your portfolio: closing the books accurately, building and leading a team of local finance experts to meet French statutory and regulatory requirements, and making sure every number that reaches Everfield's leadership is right and on time. But the job doesn't stop at accuracy. You'll sit next to Business Unit Leaders as their financial conscience and commercial sparring partner - coaching them on the numbers, challenging their growth plans, and pushing them to allocate resources where they'll actually compound.

Everfield deliberately gives this role more scope than a typical FP&A or controller seat carries at this career stage. You'll run the accounting, build and lead the regional finance team, and shape how each business thinks about growth - the full stack, across multiple companies.

What You'll Do

Own the numbers

• Be accountable for the accuracy and timeliness of monthly reporting (management P&L, KPIs, operating metrics) for each business in your portfolio - not just its preparation.

• Build and manage a team of local financial experts to meet French statutory and regulatory compliance requirements.

• Guide each business's finance and accounting team through migration onto Everfield's NetSuite instance.

• Own the accuracy and timeliness of the underlying accounting work behind every number you report.

• Build and defend annual budgets and rolling forecasts, incorporating strategic initiatives and long-term expectations.

• Prepare Quarterly Update Review (QUR) packs for Everfield's CEO, CFO, and COO.

Drive the growth agenda

• Coach Business Unit Leaders on financial acumen - make sure they understand and consistently apply the Everfield ratios, not just report against them.

• Challenge and support Business Unit Leaders in applying Everfield's prescribed revenue system to their business.

• Help each business spot operating efficiencies, report headcount accurately, and manage overhead with intent.

• Partner with Business Unit Leaders on charting expense management and aligning resources toward growth, not just cost control.

• Play an active role in integration of newly acquired businesses - systems, data, and reporting design, alongside the Integration Director and Head of BI.

• Partner with your Strategic Business Partner (SBP) counterpart on the day-to-day relationship with each business in your region.

Who We're Looking For

• An ambitious problem-solver who wants this role to be a stepping stone – experience on the path towards a CFO or Controller of a larger group of companies, or of a larger standalone business.

• Strong technical grounding in accounting practices and controls - you can run a clean close and hold a third-party provider to a standard, not just review their output.

• Commercial instinct to match: you can sit across from a Business Unit Leader and challenge their growth plan, not just report on whether they hit it.

• A completed university education plus a professional finance qualification (CA/ACA/CIMA or equivalent).

• 5+ years in Business Controlling, FP&A, or Finance Business Partnering.

• Ability to lead and build a team of regional finance specialists.

• Comfort operating in a decentralised, multi-entity, PE-backed environment - you'll manage stakeholders across businesses at very different stages of maturity.

• Fluent in English and French; effective communicator at every level of an organisation, from bookkeeper to CEO.

• Ideally, a background in fast-growing technology or SaaS companies.

• Willingness to travel occasionally.

What We Offer

• Attractive salary package with performance-based bonus.

• Remote flexibility.

• A collaborative team culture based on respect, ownership, and trust.

• Access to international experts within the Everfield ecosystem - accelerate your personal and professional growth.

description:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

 

Our Data Platform team is the engineering backbone of Tripadvisor’s data ecosystem. Formed from the core fundamentals of our Data Engineering and Software Engineering (Data Platform) groups, this unified team combines deep data pipeline expertise with robust platform engineering capabilities. 

We are responsible for providing the software and infrastructure that enable Tripadvisor to better understand visitor preferences and drive GenAI, Analytical, and DSML initiatives at petabyte scale. We build the frameworks, infrastructure, tooling, data modeling, and best practices that ensure consistent, well-governed, high-quality data products everywhere; and we directly own a deliberate set of business-critical, cross-cutting data products.

Our work spans:

  • Streaming and batch data platforms that unlock data across Tripadvisor
  • ETL pipelines and data models serving terabytes and growing datasets in Snowflake, BigQuery, and Hive
  • Orchestration, scheduling, and ETL generation tools to support cloud migrations and petabyte-scale operations
  • Tracking instrumentation, information architecture, and data governance tooling for business-critical analytics
  • Self-service and agentic analytics capabilities — governed, natural-language access to trustworthy data

The Role

Tripadvisor is looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our fast-moving Data Platform group. In this role, you will design, build, and sustain the data infrastructure that powers the world’s most trusted travel platform. You'll pair strong software engineering fundamentals with deep data engineering expertise, set technical direction, architecting reliable pipelines, and delivering end-to-end solutions that scale to hundreds of millions of travelers.

Do you enjoy building features end-to-end? Do you thrive working with a broad technology stack, releasing frequently, and collaborating with talented engineers worldwide? If so, we’d love to talk.

We collaborate closely with Product, Analytics, Data Science, CRM, Marketing, Finance, and Machine Learning teams across Tripadvisor’s global engineering organization.

 

What You'll Do

Data Engineering & Data Products & Enablement

  • Own the full lifecycle of business critical data pipelines: define SLAs, implement performance measurement, monitoring, alerting, and anomaly detection, and lead incident response and root-cause analysis.
  • Define scalable, reusable data models and curated data sets for analytics, data science, CRM, machine learning, and other data consumers across the organization.
  • Design, build, and maintain robust ETL/ELT data pipelines that process terabyte- to petabyte-scale data across Snowflake, BigQuery, and other platforms.
  • Design, build and maintain streaming and batch systems that power real-time and analytical workloads, and lead simplification of legacy ingestion paths.
  • Drive warehouse standardization and technical-debt reduction as we consolidate toward one warehouse.
  • Drive enterprise data integrity, validation, documentation, and governance practices — and the tooling that makes them the default rather than the exception.
  • Apply AI to accelerate the team's own work (e.g., building reusable Claude skills for pipeline migrations and upgrades) and share those patterns with individual teams.
  • Set and evolve engineering standards, patterns, and best practices for data modeling, pipeline design, testing, and observability.

Platform & Software Engineering

  • Write and review production Java and Python code across our evolving platform stack — from data ingestion and event processing to REST services and internal tooling
  • Architect and scale streaming and batch processing systems (Flink, Spark, Kafka) that power real-time and analytical workloads.
  • Take responsibility for all aspects of software engineering: design, implementation, QA, and maintenance, with a CI/CD mindset (most engineers release to production every few days).
  • Design, operate, and continuously improve cloud infrastructure on AWS, applying strong judgment on performance, scalability, and cost.

 

Technical Leadership, Collaboration & Ownership

  • Lead large size initiatives end to end: technical specs, design reviews, project planning, and delivery across teams.
  • Set and uphold code and data quality through leadership in design and code review, and act as a technical mentor to engineers on the team and in the domains you enable.
  • Translate ambiguous, cross-organizational data problems into clear, standardized solutions, and communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Work with independence and a mandate to leave things better than you found them, in a fast-paced, globally distributed environment.
  • Partner with Product, Design, Analytics, and Data Science leaders to shape specifications, challenge requirements constructively, and deliver high-impact solutions.

 

Skills & Experience

  • 8+ years of data engineering or software development experience in a commercial setting, including a track record of technical leadership on medium-to-large projects.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience taking significant projects from design through production, with growing ownership of technical direction
  • Deep experience designing and implementing complex ETL/ELT from concept to production, including SLAs, performance measurement, and monitoring.
  • Comprehensive data design and data modeling experience, and advanced SQL across large, complex datasets.
  • Extensive experience with big data technologies and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Hadoop/Hive) at terabyte-and-growing scale.
  • Experience building reusable frameworks, platforms, or tooling that other engineers depend on (not just point solutions).
  • Hands-on proficiency in both Python and Java for production systems.
  • Systems performance and tuning expertise, with a clear understanding of how architectural decisions affect scalability and cost.
  • Familiarity building REST services and working with event queue systems.
  • Familiarity with Linux and cloud infrastructure design on AWS or equivalent cloud providers.

Our Mission

At Omegga, we're on a mission to reinvent how AI and spectroscopy can drive positive change for animals, people and the planet. We started with a clear objective: eliminate chick culling on a global scale through early, non-invasive in-ovo sex detection. This outdated practice still impacts billions of lives, and we're here to change that. We're not building for the niche, we're building for the global standard.

Today, our systems are already in use, and the focus is on scaling performance, robustness, and deployment across an international customer base. For us, scaling means more than growth. It means changing an industry for the better.

We are looking for people who take ownership, think in systems, and want to help turn a working product into the industry benchmark. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Your Mission

You'll work directly with our Head of Finance&HR and keep the people side of Omegga running while we scale. This is not a "help out where needed" working student role. You own recurring processes end to end, and you get real responsibility from week one.

  • Onboarding & Offboarding: Own the operational employee lifecycle. Prepare contracts and documents, coordinate equipment and accounts, run structured first days, and manage clean offboardings.

  • Personio: Keep our HR system the single source of truth. Maintain employee data, absences, digital personnel files, and documentation quality, and help us get more out of the tool than we do today.

  • Recruiting Support: Draft and publish job ads, keep our applicant tracking system clean, coordinate interview scheduling, and own candidate communication so no application goes unanswered.

  • Recruiting Day: Organize our candidate day end to end: invitations, agenda, materials, interviewer briefings, and on site coordination.

  • Internal Events: Plan and run internal formats, from team events to company offsite

  • Development Budget: Take ownership of our people development budget. Build the process and guideline from scratch with us, then run it: track requests and spend, support colleagues in finding the right trainings, and keep it transparent.

  • Performance & Review Process: Help us prepare the rollout of our company wide review cycle. You build templates, timelines and tooling, and drive the internal communication around it.

Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Umsetzung komplexer Analyse-, Reporting- und Steuerungslösungen. Ausgeprägte analytische, konzeptionelle und betriebswirtschaftliche Fähigkeiten sowie eine hohe Methoden- und Problemlösungskompetenz. Sicheres Auftreten, ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Stakeholder zu überzeugen. We bring reservations, guest communication, pricing, payments, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting into one platform—helping operators automate manual work, reduce costs, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios.

We're looking for an ambitious Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer who wants to turn real customer problems into intuitive, reliable software. You'll work closely with founders, designers, and operators to identify what matters, build solutions, and improve them based on how people use them.

If you enjoy owning the full journey from customer problem to shipped product—and you're excited by AI, automation, and short-term rentals—we want to meet you.

What You'll Build

As a Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer, you'll help shape and scale Base360.ai across the entire short-term rental lifecycle.

You'll build customer-facing features, operational dashboards, automation engines, AI-powered workflows, and integrations that help property managers grow without increasing their workload at the same rate.

Your work will connect what users see with the systems behind it—from a guest’s check-in experience to the workflows coordinating reservations, cleaning, payments, and owner reporting.

Your Mission

Understand Customer Problems

Work directly with property managers and internal teams to understand their workflows, identify friction, and decide which problems are worth solving.

Build Products End-to-End

Take features from idea and prototype through frontend, backend, integrations, testing, and deployment. Own the complete experience and how it performs in production.

Create Intuitive User Experiences

Work with designers to make complex short-term rental operations easy to manage. Build interfaces that help users complete tasks quickly and confidently.

Create Powerful Automations

Build event-driven workflows that eliminate repetitive work—from scheduling cleaning after a booking to sending check-in instructions and generating owner statements.

Develop AI-Powered Features

Use LLMs and AI agents to automate guest communication, triage maintenance requests, support pricing decisions, and help operators manage their portfolios more efficiently.

Connect the Ecosystem

Build reliable APIs and integrations with platforms including Airbnb, Hostaway, Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI, Google, and other partners across the short-term rental ecosystem.

Solve Real Operational Problems

Build solutions for:

  • Real-time reservation and availability synchronization

  • Dynamic pricing intelligence

  • Smart lock access and key management

  • Automated guest communication across channels

  • Guest check-in and upsell journeys

  • Operational forecasting

  • Cleaning and maintenance automation

  • Owner reporting and financial workflows

  • AI-powered monitoring and alerts

Measure and Improve

Use customer feedback, product usage, and operational results to evaluate what you ship. Improve features based on adoption, time saved, fewer errors, and better user outcomes.

Build for Scale

Make sound technical decisions that balance delivery speed, maintainability, security, and reliability as more operators and properties join the platform.

Tech Stack

We care more about capability than specific technologies, but our current stack includes:

  • Python

  • FastAPI

  • React

  • TypeScript

  • Supabase

  • PostgreSQL

  • AWS

  • Serverless architecture

  • OpenAI APIs

  • Twilio

  • Stripe

  • Docker

  • GitHub Actions

You Might Be a Great Fit If You Have

  • Strong experience building and shipping production software

  • The ability to work across frontend and backend systems

  • Experience with React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, or similar technologies

  • Strong understanding of APIs, databases, integrations, and cloud architecture

  • A product mindset and curiosity about why users need a feature

  • Good judgment around usability, scope, and technical trade-offs

  • The ability to turn an ambiguous problem into a practical, working solution

  • Confidence working directly with customers, designers, and founders

  • The ability to work independently and own outcomes

  • Curiosity about AI, automation, and operational efficiency

  • A bias toward shipping, learning, and iterating

Bonus points for experience with:

  • Short-term rentals, hospitality technology, or property management systems

  • Multi-tenant SaaS platforms

  • Marketplace businesses and booking channel integrations

  • AI agents and workflow automation

  • Product analytics and experimentation

  • Event-driven architectures

  • Supabase

  • AWS serverless infrastructure

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 12 months:

  • You've shipped features that property managers actively use

  • Core short-term rental workflows are automated through products you've built

  • Customers spend less time on manual administration and repetitive tasks

  • Complex workflows become easier to understand and complete

  • Integrations move reservations, availability, payments, and operational data reliably

  • AI-powered features become part of customers’ everyday operations

  • Customer feedback and usage data consistently inform your product decisions

  • Your work helps operators grow their portfolios, improve guest experiences, and operate more profitably

Why Join Us

Build Something Meaningful

Solve problems experienced daily by short-term rental operators, with direct access to The Flex’s operations to test ideas and see their impact.

Own the Product Outcome

Help decide what to build, how it should work, and how to measure its success. Take responsibility for features from the first conversation through ongoing improvement.

Small Team, Massive Opportunity

Work closely with the founders and directly influence the product and technical direction of Base360.ai.

Learn Faster

Solve real-world challenges across product, software, AI, automation, hospitality operations, and scale.

Performance-Based Rewards

Competitive compensation with substantial upside for exceptional performers.

Remote-First

Work from anywhere. We care about outcomes, not hours.

This Role Is Not For You If

  • You're looking for a slow-paced corporate environment

  • You need detailed specifications before you can make progress

Base360.ai is the AI operating system for short-term rental businesses, helping property managers run their operations on autopilot.

Born out of The Flex, a short-term rental operator that scaled to an eight-figure business using its own software, Base360.ai is now launching as a standalone platform for short-term rental operators worldwide.

We bring reservations, guest communication, pricing, payments, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting into one platform—helping operators automate manual work, reduce costs, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios.

We're looking for a highly ambitious Senior Software Engineer who wants to build systems that solve real problems at scale. You'll build, ship, automate, and deliver products that directly impact property managers, their teams, and their guests.

If you're excited by APIs, automation, AI agents, cloud infrastructure, and building products from the ground up, we want to meet you.

What You'll Build

As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll help architect and scale Base360.ai—the platform powering every aspect of a short-term rental business.

You'll build customer-facing products, automation engines, AI-powered workflows, integrations, and operational systems that help property managers grow without increasing their workload at the same rate.

Your work will span the entire short-term rental lifecycle: from listing distribution, pricing, and bookings to guest stays, property operations, and financial reporting.

Build the Core Platform

Design and develop scalable applications, services, and APIs that power reservations, availability, pricing, payments, guest experiences, and property operations.

Create Powerful Automations

Build event-driven workflows that eliminate repetitive work—from scheduling cleaning after a booking to sending check-in instructions and generating owner statements.

title: Contrôleur de gestion & Data analyste
description: NOTRE ONG : Handicap International / Humanité & Inclusion (HI) est une association de solidarité internationale indépendante et impartiale, qui intervient dans les situations de pauvreté et d’exclusion, de conflits et de catastrophes. Œuvrant aux côtés des personnes handicapées et vulnérabilisées, elle agit et témoigne pour répondre à leurs besoins essentiels et améliorer leurs conditions de vie. Elle s’engage à promouvoir le respect de leur dignité et de leurs droits fondamentaux. Depuis sa création en 1982, HI a mis en place des programmes de développement dans plus de 60 pays et intervient dans de nombreuses situations d’urgence avec ses plus de 3500 collaborateurs. Chez Handicap International, nous croyons fermement en l'importance de l'inclusion et de la diversité au sein de notre structure. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés dans une politique handicap afin de favoriser l'accueil et l'intégration de personnes en situation de handicap. Merci d’indiquer si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier, y compris pour participer aux premiers entretiens. CONTEXTE : Vous intégrez le Service Contrôle de gestion Siège et Associations Nationales (AN) , dont le rôle est d'accompagner les directions et associations nationales dans le pilotage financier, budgétaire et analytique de leurs activités. Il assure la production des reportings financiers, la consolidation des données du réseau, le suivi des risques financiers et l'amélioration continue des outils et processus de gestion. Votre future équipe est constituée de 8 collaborateurs (7 à Lyon, 1 au Luxembourg), avec un périmètre international stimulant (interactions avec les États-Unis et l'Allemagne). OBJECTIFS DU POSTE : Ce poste permet d'avoir deux dimensions complémentaires : - la valorisation et la fiabilisation des données financières, - et le pilotage financier d'un portefeuille comprenant prioritairement l'Association Nationale UK. Cette articulation vise à renforcer la qualité de l'information, l'automatisation des reportings et l'aide à la décision. L’objectif est de structurer, fiabiliser, analyser et mettre à disposition les données utiles au pilotage, tout en assurant le suivi budgétaire, financier et des risques du périmètre confié. Le poste transforme les besoins métiers en indicateurs et tableaux de bord exploitables, accompagne les responsables budgétaires et contribue à l'amélioration continue des processus et systèmes d'information financiers. Ce poste permet de transformer les données complexes en véritables outils d'aide à la décision ! Requirements Votre parcours & vos expériences Formation : Diplômé(e) d'une école de commerce, d'une école d'ingénieur ou titulaire d'un Master 2 en gestion/finance. Expériences : Une solide pratique confirmée en data analyse, contrôle de gestion, reporting financier ou sur une fonction hybride finance/data. Une première expérience ou des interactions régulières avec un organe de direction type conseil d'administration serait un plus. Vos compétences techniques Maîtrise des outils : Niveau avancé sur Excel et sur un outil de data visualisation (Power BI idéalement). Data & Process : Capacité à structurer les données, formaliser des règles de gestion, automatiser les reportings et comprendre les environnements ERP, Data Warehouse et la gouvernance des données. Finance : Maîtrise solide du contrôle budgétaire, de l'analyse d'écarts, des clôtures et des réconciliations. Un plus apprécié : Connaissance de Navision, Workday, SQL ou d'outils équivalents. Vos savoir-être Rigueur & Fiabilité : Grand sens de la qualité et de l'organisation, avec une excellente gestion des priorités. NOTRE ONG :               

Handicap International / Humanité & Inclusion (HI) est une association de solidarité internationale indépendante et impartiale, qui intervient dans les situations de pauvreté et d’exclusion, de conflits et de catastrophes. Œuvrant aux côtés des personnes handicapées et vulnérabilisées, elle agit et témoigne pour répondre à leurs besoins essentiels et améliorer leurs conditions de vie. Elle s’engage à promouvoir le respect de leur dignité et de leurs droits fondamentaux. Depuis sa création en 1982, HI a mis en place des programmes de développement dans plus de 60 pays et intervient dans de nombreuses situations d’urgence avec ses plus de 3500 collaborateurs.

 

Chez Handicap International, nous croyons fermement en l'importance de l'inclusion et de la diversité au sein de notre structure. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés dans une politique handicap afin de favoriser l'accueil et l'intégration de personnes en situation de handicap.

Merci d’indiquer si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier, y compris pour participer aux premiers entretiens.

CONTEXTE :

Vous intégrez le Service Contrôle de gestion Siège et Associations Nationales (AN), dont le rôle est d'accompagner les directions et associations nationales dans le pilotage financier, budgétaire et analytique de leurs activités. Il assure la production des reportings financiers, la consolidation des données du réseau, le suivi des risques financiers et l'amélioration continue des outils et processus de gestion.

Cette articulation vise à renforcer la qualité de l'information, l'automatisation des reportings et l'aide à la décision.

L’objectif est de structurer, fiabiliser, analyser et mettre à disposition les données utiles au pilotage, tout en assurant le suivi budgétaire, financier et des risques du périmètre confié. Le poste transforme les besoins métiers en indicateurs et tableaux de bord exploitables, accompagne les responsables budgétaires et contribue à l'amélioration continue des processus et systèmes d'information financiers.

Ce poste permet de transformer les données complexes en véritables outils d'aide à la décision !

Documenter les architectures, configurations, processus et solutions afin de faciliter leur exploitation et leurs évolutions futures. Expérience avec SharePoint et Microsoft Teams, notamment sur les aspects architecture, intégration et sécurité. La connaissance de Microsoft Graph et des APIs Microsoft constitue un plus. title: Projektleiter (m/w/d) PLM & Technische Dokumentation
description: Industrie | PLM, ALM, Technische Dokumentation, SAP Du hast Einführungsprojekte im Konzernumfeld geleitet und weißt, wie man Fachbereiche, IT und Anbieter auf ein gemeinsames Ziel ausrichtet und Entscheidungen durch die Gremien bringt. Genau diese Erfahrung suchen wir. Impecto Consulting ist eine Beratung aus Düsseldorf für Industrieunternehmen mit gewachsenen Prozess- und Systemlandschaften. Unser Thema ist Produktinformation von der Anforderung bis zum Service: die Prozesse und Systeme, die Informationen aus Entwicklung und Konstruktion durchgängig bis in Dokumentation und Service tragen – PLM, ALM, ERP, Redaktionssysteme, Verwaltungsschale. Wir bereiten Vorhaben so auf, dass sie entschieden werden können, und steuern anschließend die Umsetzung. Die Einführung der Systeme übernehmen die Anbieter; wir arbeiten herstellerneutral. Wir sind ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen zur Geschäftsführung. Aufgaben Du leitest bei unseren Kunden die Umsetzung von Vorhaben rund um Produktinformation und die Systeme, in denen sie entsteht und genutzt wird – bei Konzernen ebenso wie im Mittelstand. Du begleitest die Fachbereiche durch Anforderungsaufnahme, Test und Migration und stimmst die Projektarbeit mit ihrem Tagesgeschäft ab. Du steuerst die Anbieter auf Ebene der Lieferobjekte, bereitest Gremienentscheidungen vor und stellst sie gemeinsam mit dem Kunden vor. Für den Kunden bist du der Ansprechpartner für Planung, Fortschritt und Steuerung des Projekts. Die fachliche Lösung – Konzept, Datenarchitektur, Semantik – gestaltest du gemeinsam mit unseren Senior Consultants. Zwei Schwerpunkte prägen unsere Projekte derzeit. In der technischen Dokumentation geht es um die Ablösung von Redaktionssystemen und Dokumentations-Toolchains und ihre Anbindung an PLM und SAP, damit Informationen aus Konstruktion und ERP durchgängig in Anleitungen, Ersatzteilkataloge und Serviceunterlagen fließen. Im Bereich ALM und Requirements Management geht es um die Einführung von Anforderungs- und Änderungsmanagement auf Plattformen wie Codebeamer und die Verknüpfung mit PLM, damit Anforderungen von der Entwicklung bis zur Freigabe nachvollziehbar bleiben. Darüber hinaus arbeitest du in unseren Orientierungs- und Entscheidungsprojekten mit, in denen wir Vorhaben vor der Umsetzung aufsetzen: Du sichtest Systemlandschaften, bewertest Anbieter und planst den Weg in die Umsetzung. So begleitest du Projekte von der ersten Einordnung bis in den Betrieb. Qualifikation Sechs bis zehn Jahre Berufserfahrung, davon mindestens drei als Projektleiter in Einführungs- oder Ablöseprojekten mit Schnittstelle zu Fachbereichen und Anbietern. Erfahrung im Konzernumfeld mit Lenkungskreisen oder vergleichbaren Gremien. Fundierte Kenntnis in mindestens einem dieser Bereiche und ein Verständnis für die angrenzenden: PLM (etwa Teamcenter, Windchill), technische Dokumentation (etwa SCHEMA ST4, Arbortext, Docufy, DITA) ALM und Requirements Management (etwa Codebeamer, Polarion, DOORS, Jama) oder SAP. Sicherheit in Arbeitspaketplanung, Risikomanagement, Abnahmen und Anbietersteuerung. Deutsch auf verhandlungssicherem Niveau, gutes Englisch, Reisebereitschaft zum Kunden. Studium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens, des Maschinenbaus oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Erfahrung in der Projektleitung auf Anbieter- oder Partnerseite ist für uns ebenso wertvoll wie Beratungserfahrung. Benefits Projektleitungsverantwortung vom ersten Tag an Enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Senior Consultants und direkter Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung. Die Möglichkeit, Beratungsangebot und Kundenbeziehungen einer wachsenden Beratung mitzugestalten Hybrides Arbeiten mit Sitz in Düsseldorf Ein Anschreiben ist nicht nötig. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze zu einem Projekt, das du geleitet hast. Innerhalb einer Woche melden wir uns für ein erstes Gespräch mit Tim Jansen, Geschäftsführer. Im zweiten Gespräch bearbeiten wir gemeinsam einen Fall aus einem unserer Projekte – so lernen wir uns fachlich kennen. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Counsel, Strategic Partnerships
description:
About Coursera + Udemy

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI.

Why join us now?

AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.

Shape what comes next

By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.

Where we Work

Udemy is a global company headquartered in San Francisco, with additional U.S. offices in Denver and Austin, and international hubs in Australia, India, Ireland, Mexico, and Türkiye. 

About this role

This is a senior in-house legal role for a commercially driven lawyer ready to take commercial legal programs work with partners and negotiate technology deals. The role reports directly to the Head of Commercial Legal, Strategic Growth.
 
We operate a hybrid go-to-market model that combines demand-led direct sales, solution-led growth, and indirect distribution through a tiered partner and channel ecosystem. We reach organizations globally through technology alliances, GSI relationships, channel partners, and reseller arrangements — powering learning and capability-building at scale. Legal sits at the center of all three motions.
 
You will be a dedicated legal partner for B2B Enterprise, Technology Alliances, and Channel and Distribution Partnerships, supporting the development and negotiation of the indirect partner ecosystem that underpins our scalable distribution. This is a role for someone who combines deep transactional expertise with strong business instincts, operates with a high degree of independence, and is ready to grow into broader leadership responsibility within a scaling legal function.

About your skills

  • Exceptional business judgement and a proven ability to balance legal risk with commercial objectives in fast-moving deal environments.

  • Executive-level communication skills: able to distill complex issues into clear, actionable guidance and influence stakeholders from SMB to large enterprise and C-suite.

  • A track record of using approved AI tools to increase legal productivity, and staying current on AI governance obligations.

What you’ll be doing  

B2B Enterprise, Ecosystems and Technology Transactions

  • Take primary ownership of drafting, reviewing, and negotiating complex commercial agreements across global system integrator arrangements, channel partner and reseller agreements, technology alliance and co-sell agreements, enterprise SaaS and platform licensing, API and technical integration agreements, and distribution and go-to-market partnerships.

  • Advise senior business stakeholders, including GTM leadership, and Product teams, on deal structuring, risk allocation, commercial terms, and multi-jurisdictional GTM considerations, serving as the day-to-day legal lead who positions Legal as a genuine business enabler.

  • Partner with the Product Legal team to develop and refine legal frameworks that support a self-serve and low-touch commercial motion, including API access agreements, developer terms, usage-based licensing structures, and SMB onboarding frameworks, contributing to a standardized, scalable approach that enables businesses to engage and onboard with speed and minimal friction.

  • Provide clear, solution-focused guidance on AI-related commercial arrangements, data-sharing agreements, and emerging technology implementations as they enter the enterprise deal mix.

  • Own and continuously develop the suite of enterprise and channel contracting templates, playbooks, negotiation guidelines, and approval frameworks used across the partnerships function.

  • Design scalable legal infrastructure that empowers fast-moving deal teams to execute efficiently while maintaining sound risk controls across both direct and indirect channels.

  •  

GTM Product Commercialisation and Third-Party Integration

  • Act as a primary legal partner for the commercialisation of GTM products, advising on go-to-market structures, route-to-market models, pricing and packaging frameworks, and the legal terms that govern how products are brought to market directly and through third parties.

  • Draft and negotiate agreements that govern the embedding, bundling, or distribution of our products within third-party platforms, marketplaces, and ecosystems, including white-label arrangements, OEM agreements, co-branded offerings, and platform integration terms.

  • Advise on licensing boundaries and revenue-sharing constructs as the product suite evolves and is commercialised through an expanding range of direct and indirect channels.

  • Work closely with Product, Product Legal, Marketing, and Sales to ensure commercial and legal structures keep pace with product development and new route-to-market initiatives, flagging and resolving legal considerations early in the product lifecycle.

What you’ll have 

  • Genuinely commercial in your approach: able to identify and manage risk pragmatically, find workable solutions under pressure, and avoid being a blocker to growth.

  • An effective communicator and influencer, comfortable advising and challenging senior stakeholders across Sales, Product, and Executive leadership.

  • Qualified lawyer with 10+ years of post-qualification experience, including meaningful in-house tenure at a technology, SaaS, or enterprise software company.

  • A proven track record negotiating complex B2B technology agreements including GSI, channel, reseller, alliance, and enterprise platform deals, ideally within or alongside global organisations.

  • Demonstrable experience advising on product commercialisation, route-to-market strategy, or third-party distribution and embedding arrangements.

  • Comfortable operating across both high-touch enterprise deals and high-volume standardised indirect channel frameworks, understanding that each requires a different legal posture.

  • Highly organised and self-directed, with a demonstrated ability to manage a high-volume deal workload across competing priorities and deadlines with minimal supervision.

  • A collaborative team player who understands their place in a broader legal function and actively supports those around them, including upward to leadership

 

Posting Date: 15 September 2026
Application Window: 2 weeks
We anticipate the application window will be open until 30 September 2026. Based on business needs, this opportunity may remain posted beyond or closed before the anticipated application window.

#LI-ST5

 

Why work here?

You’ll grow here.
Learning is part of the job. You’ll get full access to Udemy courses, a monthly UDay to invest in yourself, and a budget to spend on whatever helps you improve. Many people are diving into AI lately, but what you focus on is up to you.

AI is real here.
We use it in the way we learn and the way we work. You’ll have the space and tools to experiment, apply, and get better at using AI in practical ways.

You’ll own your work.
We trust people to lead, make decisions, and follow through. You don’t need to wait for permission or layers of approval to have an impact.

You’ll build with others.
We collaborate openly and shape ideas together. Everyone has a voice, and good thinking is welcomed from any direction.

You’ll see your impact.
What you build helps people grow their skills, change their careers, or find a path forward. You’ve got the experience, why not use it to help others gain theirs?

Bring your curiosity. We’ll bring the platform and the support. Let’s LEARN together. 

Our Benefits Start with U

Our benefits start with you and were built to provide you and your family with the protection and care you need, making it easy to access the right coverage when you need it most. Benefits vary by region, and we encourage applicants to review our Australia Benefits, India Benefits, Ireland Benefits, Mexico Benefits, Turkiye Benefits & US Benefits, pages to get an understanding of some of the benefits we offer. For details on region-specific benefits, please refer to the information provided during the hiring process. 

Benefits outlined are provided as a general overview and may vary depending on the location, role, and employment classification. All benefits are subject to change at the discretion of the organization and in accordance with applicable laws and policies.
 
At Udemy, we value diversity and inclusion and consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or family status, veteran status, medical condition, or disability. We understand that not everyone will match each of the qualifications. However, we also realize that everyone has unique experiences that can add value to our company. Even if you think your background might not perfectly align, we'd love to hear from you! 
 
To protect against recruitment fraud, Coursera + Udemy recruiters only communicate via official coursera.org/udemy.com email addresses and never through personal accounts. We do not accept resumes via email or social media; please submit all applications directly through our careers page. If you encounter suspicious recruitment activity, please report it via our Fraudulent Activity Submission Form.

Give you an ambiguous problem and you'll work it out: find the mess, own it, fix it. You're a business partner, not a back-office cop: You work close to Sales, Marketing, and the wider team, helping everyone spend smarter and move faster. You know the highest-leverage thing finance can do here is accelerate growth — nudging our treasury yield from 2.7% to 2.9% is not the job. You're all-in: Solve is fast and intense, and this isn't a 9–5. You get passionate — even obsessive — about the problems you own. Deep fluency in accounting — you can run external accountants to an on-time close — without needing to be an accountant yourself. A track record of implementing finance processes, tooling, and automation that scale with a fast-growing company. Strong modelling skills across budgets, forecasts, P&L, and cash. Exceptionally clear written and verbal communication. title: Senior Product Manager: Recall
description: About Us Constructor powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you’ve probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We’re approximately doubling year over year despite the market slowing down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We’re a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things. Job Summary We’re looking for a highly technical, systems-minded Senior Product Manager to lead two critical search intelligence teams: Machine Learning & Recall and Query . Search at Constructor is fundamentally an ML challenge, and this role sits at the absolute entry point of our discovery pipeline, right where shopper intent meets candidate retrieval. In this role, you will bridge the Query team (understanding what a shopper means across intent, entities, and language) with the Machine Learning & Recall team (retrieving the exact right set of candidate products across massive catalogs). You will define strategy across both domains, balancing state-of-the-art techniques, such as vector search, semantic parsing, dense embeddings, and LLM-assisted query interpretation, with low-latency production execution. You won’t be measured on shipping features for the sake of it; you’ll be measured on candidate quality, query accuracy, and driving business outcomes like conversion rate, search-attributed revenue, and revenue per visit. What You’ll Do Set a unified roadmap: Define the multi-quarter vision and strategy across both the Machine Learning & Recall and Query teams, ensuring query understanding and candidate generation evolve hand-in-hand. Drive Query intelligence: Lead the Query team to push boundaries in tokenization, spell correction, entity extraction, intent classification, and LLM-assisted query parsing across multiple languages. Advance Recall systems: Lead the Machine Learning & Recall team in evolving candidate generation architecture, seamlessly combining traditional keyword search with modern dense embeddings, vector retrieval, and hybrid recall models. Move core business metrics: Own measurable lift in search-attributed conversion, revenue per visit, and GMV across all retail customer verticals. Turn research into production wins: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with ML researchers, data scientists, and software engineers to take SOTA models from research to low-latency, cost-effective production systems. Balance ML performance trade-offs: Make data-backed decisions balancing model complexity, accuracy, inference latency, compute costs, and real-time execution constraints. Build evaluation frameworks: Establish robust offline and online measurement systems to evaluate retrieval precision and query understanding accuracy against customer revenue outcomes. Orchestrate pipeline handoffs: Ensure candidate product sets and query context flow cleanly into downstream ranking and search quality models without signal loss. Solve systemic issues: Lead technical triage when query interpretation or retrieval anomalies occur, building durable, automated fixes rather than one-off patches. What Success Looks Like Within your first year, you will have: Evolved our hybrid recall framework to measurably improve candidate generation precision for long-tail queries and complex catalog structures. Driven quantifiable lift in search-attributed conversion and revenue per visit across major customer verticals. Stood up an integrated evaluation framework connecting query parsing and candidate recall directly to business outcomes. Optimized inference latency and compute infrastructure to ensure high-capacity ML models run fast and cost-effectively in production. Company-sponsored US health coverage (100% paid for employee). Fully remote team - choose where you live. Work-from-home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office. Apple laptops provided for new employees. Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year. Every shift released in sortation, every middle-mile van dispatched, every last-mile route planned, every expansion decision made - all downstream of models that predict how parcels move through our system. When those models are right, the network runs efficiently and cost per parcel drops. When they drift, the cost compounds across every stage of the operation. The Network squad builds and maintains the forecasting engine that powers all of it, and Demand Forecasting is its core: one forecast of what will be available to sort, at outcode granularity, from D0 out to D30. As a Staff Data Scientist, you are the technical anchor for Demand Forecasting. You own the hardest and most ambiguous parts of the forecast, and you set the methodology and validation standards the rest of the area works to. That means owning the single integrated forecast of what volume the network will have to move, by area and out to thirty days, which the demand-management layer then turns into the operational plan the sort centres and transport teams run on. It means owning the model-driven end of that forecast, where the horizon runs past any live tracking data and expected parcels have to be generated from models rather than observed. It means owning the forecast of inbound international volume, one of the hardest prediction problems we have. And it means owning the models that predict each parcel's size and weight, which turn a parcel count into the physical volume that actually has to be sorted and loaded. This is a hands-on role. You will spend most of your time building, not managing. You set the direction for how Demand Forecasting models, evaluates and ships its work, and you raise the technical bar across the area, but you do it as the most senior individual contributor in the room, on the tools. Own production quality across the estate, working with the ML Engineer so that models are monitored, drift is caught early, and accuracy problems are traced to the right cause rather than re-tuned blindly. Work with Finance, who extend the operational forecasts into longer-range financial projections, to keep the handoff between operational and financial models reliable. Quantify the impact of model error on cost per parcel, and use it to decide where the area invests effort. Who Will Thrive in This Role? You have been the technical anchor on a modelling team before. You've owned the hardest problems, set the standards others worked to, and been the person the team turned to when an approach needed a call. A demand forecast isn't just a number; it drives how many shifts are opened, how many vans are dispatched and how routes are planned, and it feeds a downstream planning decision and the network's expansion models. You care about how your models connect to the models around them, and you design their interfaces deliberately. A deep track record of building and delivering models from ambiguous starting points. You understand the problem, build something useful, validate it against real operations, and iterate. You evaluate models well beyond standard offline metrics, connecting outputs to downstream applications and business KPIs and measuring how improvements translate into operational impact. Strong Python and SQL, and depth across the full modelling lifecycle - from data extraction and feature engineering through training, validation and production deployment. You've worked with time-series forecasting across classical statistical approaches, gradient boosting and deep learning, and you understand the trade-offs well enough to make and defend the choice for a given problem. You'll be supported by a dedicated ML Engineer, but you set the standard for how the area's models are built. You know a model isn't done when it trains well; it's done when it's running, monitored, and trusted. You communicate with non-technical stakeholders with authority. The squads that consume the forecasts need to trust them, and that trust comes from explaining what the models do, where they're reliable, and where they're not, without hiding behind the maths. You're comfortable using AI tools - LLMs, code assistants, and similar - to accelerate your workflow, from exploratory analysis to code generation, and you're curious about where these tools can augment the modelling process itself. This role suits someone who wants to see whether their models made a real difference to how the network operates. There is a direct feedback loop between your work and operational outcomes, and as the Staff DS you own the most consequential end of it. Logistics or delivery network experience is a plus, but what matters more is the ability to learn a complex operational domain quickly and model it well. Overview

The Operations Strategy Associate role is a generalist role at Clipboard suited for the “all-around athlete” type who can do it all and wants exposure to a range of problems and opportunities.

You’re likely someone who’s interested in and capable of solving different problem types, you’re resourceful, adaptable, and confident you can figure it out if you can sink your teeth in deep enough. These are the ingredients for a problem-solver who is eager to flex into multiple different types of roles and responsibilities depending on what’s needed and most impactful.

While we know that you'll likely start working within one of our Operations teams, we don’t know exactly what work or projects you’ll drive out of the gate, so you’ll notice the work we’re advertising isn’t entirely specific. Some candidates may begin in more execution-focused roles within Operations, depending on their strengths, while others may take on project or team leadership earlier on.

But we’ll make a few promises about the role: it will be high-impact, fast-paced work that directly affects our customers, product, and business.

 

What You May Do

Because you'll be joining the business where your strengths and our highest priorities intersect, no two Associates have exactly the same experience. Here are a few examples of the types of work you may own:

  • Redesign our process for reaching out to workplaces about converting them to new methods of payment, such as getting customers who send checks to start paying us via eCheck to speed up the cash conversion process.

  • Research, vet, and onboard a new vendor that embeds AI agents into our customer-facing efforts.

  • Build an internal predictive analytics model to catch bad payers earlier with high accuracy.

  • Spearhead a quality task force that ensures top quality for our biggest customers.

  • Manage a team of agents within one of our Operations teams.

  • Work directly within workflows, including handling customer interactions, resolving issues, and identifying opportunities to improve the front line processes.

 

Who we're looking for

We find those who are most successful in this type of role:

  • Are insatiably curious and notice non-obvious clues and patterns: Curiosity sits atop our company values. Understanding something from first principles and getting to the root cause of the problem will often reveal the best solution, and a natural and unwavering curiosity to keep asking questions and digging will take you most of the way.

  • Roll up their sleeves and go to the source: There are multiple ways to say this: touching reality, dogfooding, seeing for yourself, going to the front-lines, etc. Don’t just take someone’s word for it – go find out yourself by testing the feature, or listening to the agent call, or calling the customer, or executing the workflow.   • Bring a tenacity and persistence to problem-solving: You’ll hit walls and find yourself in uncertain and unfamiliar situations. If you can sit with the uncertainty, look at the problem from new angles, and keep applying pressure to a problem – you’ll position yourself for breakthroughs.

  • Bounce back from failure quickly: You’ll make mistakes, move in the wrong direction, and stumble from time-to-time. Just avoid big mistakes and don’t make the same mistakes twice, and learn from them quickly. Worry less about failing and more about losing momentum in your feedback loop. If you fail cheaply and quickly, that's worth the lesson/learning you get in return.
