title: Leiter:in Buchhaltung (m/w/d)
description: Unser Mandant ist ein traditionsreiches Unternehmen mit Sitz in Mülheim an der Ruhr. Die mittelständisch geprägte Kultur zeichnet sich durch direkte Kommunikation, kurze Entscheidungswege, pragmatische Zusammenarbeit und einen hohen Anspruch an Verlässlichkeit und Selbstorganisation aus. Zu Verstärkung der Finanzabteilung suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Leiter:in Buchhaltung (m/w/d). Aufgaben Als Leiter:in Buchhaltung (m/w/d) verantworten Sie die Finanzbuchhaltung eigenständig und übernehmen die fachliche sowie organisatorische Führung des Teams. Sie arbeiten als „mitarbeitende Führungskraft“ auch inhaltlich bei den Abschlüssen mit, Ihr Schwerpunkt liegt jedoch auf Organisation, Qualitätssicherung, Prozessverbesserung und der adressatengerechten Aufbereitung von Informationen für das Management. Sie führen und organisieren die Finanzbuchhaltung fachlich und organisatorisch und steuern die Aufgaben inhaltlich. Sie verantworten Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB, plausibilisieren Abschlusspositionen und Entwicklungen und stellen eine nachvollziehbare Dokumentation sicher. Sie koordinieren die Zusammenarbeit mit Wirtschaftsprüfungen, Steuerberatungen und weiteren externen Ansprechpersonen und klären bilanzielle Sachverhalte in Abstimmung mit der Leitung Finanzen. Sie entwickeln Management-Reportings und buchhaltungsbezogene Analysen weiter, untersuchen Plan-Ist-Abweichungen, Cashflow- und Ergebnisentwicklungen und bereiten Entscheidungsgrundlagen für das Management auf. Sie etablieren und überwachen Rechnungslegungs-, Dokumentations- und interne Richtlinien sowie Maßnahmen zur nachhaltigen Qualitätssicherung und Fehlerprävention. Sie übernehmen als wichtiges Startprojekt die Auswahl und Einführung einer neuen Finanzbuchhaltungs- beziehungsweise ERP-Lösung mit dem Ziel, wiederkehrende Abläufe möglichst weitgehend zu standardisieren und zu automatisieren. Qualifikation Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium, beispielsweise in Betriebswirtschaft oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften, eine Qualifikation als Bilanzbuchhalter (m/w/d) oder eine vergleichbare praktische Qualifikation. Sie bringen mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Rechnungswesen sowie Erfahrung in einer fachlich oder organisatorisch führenden Funktion mit. Sie verfügen über sehr gute HGB-Kenntnisse und fundierte Erfahrung in der Finanzbuchhaltung, bei Abschlussprozessen sowie in der Plausibilisierung und Analyse von Abschlusspositionen. Sie arbeiten sicher mit ERP- beziehungsweise Finanzbuchhaltungssystemen und Excel und bringen idealerweise Erfahrung in der Analyse und Modellierung von Finanzdaten mit. Sie arbeiten strukturiert, selbstständig, verlässlich und diskret, verfügen über eine hohe Zahlen- und Qualitätsaffinität und treffen professionelle Einschätzungen auch bei komplexen Sachverhalten. Sie kommunizieren komplexe Inhalte klar und adressatengerecht mit Management, internen Schnittstellen, Wirtschaftsprüfungen und externen Beratungen; gute Englischkenntnisse runden Ihr Profil ab. Benefits Sie übernehmen eine verantwortungsvolle Schlüsselposition an der Schnittstelle zwischen operativer Finanzarbeit und Management. Sie gestalten die Organisation, Qualitätssicherung und Digitalisierung der Finanzbuchhaltung aktiv mit und begleiten die Einführung einer neuen Finanzbuchhaltungs- beziehungsweise ERP-Lösung. Sie arbeiten in einem traditionsreichen, familiengeführten Unternehmen mit langfristiger Perspektive, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und wertschätzender Unternehmenskultur. Sie profitieren von 30 Urlaubstagen, Vertrauensarbeitszeit und bis zu zwei Tagen mobilem Arbeiten pro Woche. Ein attraktives Konditionenpaket und ein strukturiertes Onboarding und eine umfassende Einarbeitung runden das Angebot ab. description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Science Writer, Nebius Academy (Contract) based in France. As an AI Science Writer, you’ll translate cutting-edge AI and machine learning research into accurate, engaging, and accessible stories. You’ll work at the intersection of scientific research, technical communication, journalism, and multimedia storytelling. A core part of the role will be reviewing new models, architectures, papers, and research to identify what is genuinely novel and important. You’ll turn complex technical concepts into compelling written and visual narratives through articles, explainers, diagrams, charts, and other formats. You’ll engage directly with researchers, engineers, founders, and scientific leaders to investigate ideas and verify technical claims. The role also offers opportunities to cover major conferences, host research-focused events, and experiment with AI-assisted editorial workflows. This is an ongoing contract position with a fixed monthly retainer, flexibility, and potential opportunities for longer-term career growth. Accountabilities Produce accurate and engaging scientific and technical reviews covering new AI models, architectures, research papers, internal research, and emerging trends. Analyze technical papers and research findings to identify meaningful innovations, understand methodologies, evaluate limitations, and communicate their significance. Transform complex model architectures and technical concepts into clear visual narratives, including infographics, diagrams, charts, and other multimedia elements. Develop written content across multiple formats, including analytical reports, long-form features, interviews, technical explainers, newsletters, webinar scripts, and social media content. Interview researchers, engineers, founders, and scientific leaders to uncover insights and provide context for stories. Cover major AI research conferences, emerging fields, significant developments, and important discussions across the AI ecosystem. Host or moderate research webinars, interviews, and other on-camera or multimedia formats. Work directly with researchers to fact-check and verify technical claims while maintaining a clear, engaging editorial voice. Collaborate with designers and multimedia producers on more complex visual and interactive stories. Create visual assets independently where appropriate, using AI tools and other relevant technologies to support the production process. Experiment with AI models, agents, coding, and automation to improve research, editorial, analysis, and visual-production workflows. Contribute to an editorial environment focused on making advanced scientific research accessible without oversimplifying its underlying complexity. Requirements: Professional or academic experience in AI/ML research, machine learning engineering, or a closely related technical discipline. A degree in computer science, machine learning, mathematics, physics, engineering, computational science, or another relevant technical field. Strong ability to read and interpret scientific papers, inspect model architectures, compare experimental results, and discuss technical details directly with researchers. Strong technical writing and editorial skills, with the ability to communicate complex scientific concepts accurately, clearly, and engagingly. Strong visual communication instincts and the ability to explain technical mechanisms through diagrams, infographics, charts, and other multimedia formats. Ability to assess the significance and limitations of research rather than simply summarize findings. Excellent interviewing and communication skills, with confidence engaging researchers, engineers, and technical experts. Comfortable working across multiple content formats and adapting technical material for different audiences and channels. Familiarity with LLMs and AI-assisted content or research workflows, using these tools to enhance productivity while maintaining personal editorial judgement and authorship. title: Staff Frontend Engineer - Design Systems
description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. We at Pleo are on a mission to make spend management surprisingly effective and empowering. We build a product used by thousands of companies across Europe, and our design system is a core part of delivering a consistent, accessible, high-quality experience. We’re hiring a Staff Engineer to join the Design Systems team. This will help lead the engineering direction and execution of our design system across web and mobile. What Design Systems does Own and evolve Telescope , Pleo’s design system (components, patterns, guidelines, and tooling). Enable product teams to ship faster with consistent UI, accessibility, and quality. Partner with Design and Engineering across the company to drive adoption and improve the contribution experience. Steward shared foundations (tokens, components, documentation, and best practices). What you’ll be doing As a Staff Engineer in Design Systems, you will be a force multiplier for product delivery and UI quality across Pleo Set technical direction for key parts of Telescope (architecture, component standards, release practices, and quality bars) Drive and evolve our contribution model and how teams interact with Design Systems Own and improve how requests flow into the team (triage, prioritisation, and expectations) Improve the developer and contributor experience through tooling and automation, including: Design system visual testing and workflows Supporting internal operational needs where relevant Improving how we measure and communicate adoption and system health Evolving our docs publishing workflow Lead rituals that keep the team effective and aligned Represent Design Systems in cross-team initiatives and align stakeholders across Design and Engineering Coach and mentor engineers, and help grow technical leadership in the frontend community Contribute hands-on in code. This role blends strategy and execution. You should expect to be coding a meaningful part of the time. You’ll bring solid experience with Building and maintaining component libraries or platform-like products that serve multiple teams. TypeScript and modern frontend engineering (React experience is a plus). Designing maintainable systems with clear boundaries, versioning, and backwards compatibility. Testing practices and tooling (unit, integration, end-to-end) and a strong quality mindset. Accessibility and performance best practices for UI systems. Collaboration with designers and product engineers, and navigating tradeoffs across stakeholders. Your colleagues would say you Lead by example and raise the bar with pragmatism and care. Communicate clearly, listen well, and bring people along in decisions. Enjoy breaking down complex problems, gathering input, and driving to a solution. Coach others and create space for people to grow. Prefer progress over perfection, while still caring deeply about quality. Show me the benefits! Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!) Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work About your application English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us. A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails. Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us. Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you. Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here . Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role. Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

raw.jobDescription:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

We at Pleo are on a mission to make spend management surprisingly effective and empowering. We build a product used by thousands of companies across Europe, and our design system is a core part of delivering a consistent, accessible, high-quality experience.

We’re hiring a Staff Engineer to join the Design Systems team. This will help lead the engineering direction and execution of our design system across web and mobile.

What Design Systems does

  • Own and evolve Telescope, Pleo’s design system (components, patterns, guidelines, and tooling).

  • Enable product teams to ship faster with consistent UI, accessibility, and quality.

  • Partner with Design and Engineering across the company to drive adoption and improve the contribution experience.

  • Steward shared foundations (tokens, components, documentation, and best practices).

What you’ll be doing

As a Staff Engineer in Design Systems, you will be a force multiplier for product delivery and UI quality across Pleo

  • Set technical direction for key parts of Telescope (architecture, component standards, release practices, and quality bars)

  • Drive and evolve our contribution model and how teams interact with Design Systems

  • Own and improve how requests flow into the team (triage, prioritisation, and expectations)

  • Improve the developer and contributor experience through tooling and automation, including:

    • Design system visual testing and workflows

    • Supporting internal operational needs where relevant

    • Improving how we measure and communicate adoption and system health

    • Evolving our docs publishing workflow

  • Lead rituals that keep the team effective and aligned

  • Represent Design Systems in cross-team initiatives and align stakeholders across Design and Engineering

  • Coach and mentor engineers, and help grow technical leadership in the frontend community

  • Contribute hands-on in code. This role blends strategy and execution. You should expect to be coding a meaningful part of the time.

You’ll bring solid experience with

  • Building and maintaining component libraries or platform-like products that serve multiple teams.

  • TypeScript and modern frontend engineering (React experience is a plus).

  • Designing maintainable systems with clear boundaries, versioning, and backwards compatibility.

  • Testing practices and tooling (unit, integration, end-to-end) and a strong quality mindset.

  • Accessibility and performance best practices for UI systems.

  • Collaboration with designers and product engineers, and navigating tradeoffs across stakeholders.

Your colleagues would say you

  • Lead by example and raise the bar with pragmatism and care.

  • Communicate clearly, listen well, and bring people along in decisions.

  • Enjoy breaking down complex problems, gathering input, and driving to a solution.

  • Coach others and create space for people to grow.

  • Prefer progress over perfection, while still caring deeply about quality.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring Rust Engineering Leads of all levels of experience to drive the adoption of this exciting language into the full range of Canonical offerings, starting with Ubuntu but also our own projects and open source offerings. We see Rust as an important new language for system level services and capabilities, and a natural evolution path for the sort of software that would traditionally have been written in C or C++. We believe that there is an opportunity to rethink the foundations of future Linux systems with Rust as a central driver of change in everything from the system firmware and embedded software, bootloaders, up through the kernel and input handling, all the way to the desktop. 

We also want to ensure that Ubuntu is the very best platform for Rust development, offering easy access to the widest range of tooling and capabilities that support cutting edge open source and enterprise development.

This job posting is our general process for Rust engineers of all levels of seniority, for all relevant teams at Canonical. Apply here if you are an exceptional software engineer who prefers to work in Rust. After the first round of interviews we’ll find the best fit product team at Canonical for you to progress your application based on your personal interests.

Canonical has substantial projects in Python, Go, C, C++ and we are starting to invest in Rust. For front-end development we prefer React and Flutter.

Join us in our mission to deliver innovative open-source solutions to individuals and enterprises around the world. We expect the highest engineering standards and strong motivation to get things done well in a fully home-based and distributed environment. These roles require extensive personal experience with Linux - the more different versions of Linux the better!

Location: we have open roles for Rust engineers in every time zone.

What your day will look like

  • Design and implement well-tested and well-documented software in Rust
  • Advocate for Rust adoption in Canonical and upstream projects
  • Identify projects and codebases that could be prioritised for Rust adoption
  • Debug and fix issues encountered by your users
  • Participate in our engineering process through code and architectural reviews
  • Collaborate with community and colleagues on technical specifications
  • Seek improvements to engineering and operations practices
  • In some cases, deploy and operate services developed by the team
  • Contribute to the success of your product through technical advocacy

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • For more senior roles, experience building, deploying, and operating distributed systems and APIs
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Well-organised, self-starting and able to deliver to schedule
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Professional manner interacting with colleagues, partners, and community
  • Experience designing and writing high-quality Rust software on Linux
  • Experience with and passion for Linux at the system level
  • Professional written and spoken English 
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability 
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation 
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments 
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Nice-to-have skills we would value

  • Experience developing for Ubuntu
  • Experience with LXD, MicroK8s, SnapD, IoT, Juju, Ubuntu Core, Ubuntu Pro
  • Performance engineering and security experience

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Senior Software Engineer - (Connect Platform)
description: About Enode The grid was built for predictable, centralised power. Today it's absorbing intermittent supply from grid scale solar and wind, alongside dynamic demand from EVs, heat pumps, and home batteries. The missing piece is software that can connect and orchestrate these devices at scale. Enode provides the infrastructure layer that makes this possible. Our Connect API gives energy companies a single integration to 1000+ devices across 80+ brands. Our optimisation tooling gives energy companies the building blocks to manage those devices locally - think smart charging for EVs. Our Flex product turns those connected devices into a flexible, controllable asset for energy companies. We work with device manufacturers across the energy hardware ecosystem - from EV brands to heat pump and solar inverter producers. Our customers are energy retailers, utilities, and traders building the next generation of energy services. We're backed by Y Combinator, Lowercarbon Capital, and Creandum. The decisions made now will shape how the energy system gets built. We're looking for people who take ownership, move fast, and care deeply about the role technology can play in the energy transition. What we're looking for: We’re hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to make Enode’s EV platform more reliable, observable, and efficient. As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Platform Connect team at Enode, you'll focus on improving the reliability, observability, and scalability of Enode's connectivity layer. This is the part of our API that aggregates integrations with EV chargers, vehicles, and OEM platforms into one cohesive and reliable product for our customers. This is not an infrastructure or DevOps role. The Platform Connect team owns the product level platform that powers connectivity at Enode, maintaining and extending the layer that links our users to energy devices through consistent, high quality integrations. You'll take on complex, critical for the business work and see it through, helping keep our platform robust as we scale to more OEMs and partners. Alongside the other senior engineers on the team, you'll help set the technical bar and support the people around you. Expect to move between hands on building, shaping technical direction, and helping teammates, depending on what the team needs most. Our tech stack centers around a TypeScript based codebase combined with React, Node, AWS, Docker, and PostgreSQL, structured via CDK/CloudFormation. In this role, you will: Build and maintain API integrations with OEMs and energy partners, ensuring they are reliable, performant, and well tested. Strengthen the connectivity platform by reducing incidents and improving observability, monitoring, and alerting, including the automations and internal tools that make this easier. Take on complex projects and drive them through to release, breaking them into actionable work and delivering with limited hand-holding. Help hold a high bar on code quality, testing, and observability, caring about the state of the codebase beyond your own changes. Work with product and the team to align platform priorities, balancing stability with delivery. Take ownership beyond your own work and support the engineers around you, sharing knowledge and contributing to technical decisions that keep the team aligned. This role will be right for you, if: See AI as a strategic lever for engineering work, not just a productivity add on. AI is a real part of how we work as engineers at Enode. We expect a senior engineer to be fluent with it. Using it day to day, understanding where it helps and where it falls short, and thinking about your work in terms of what AI can take on. If you're not fully there yet, we're looking for someone eager to get there fast. Additionally: You have experience writing maintainable, testable backend code, ideally in an environment with a lot of API or integration work. You're excited about platform engineering in the product sense. Building the connectivity layer that powers integrations, not managing infrastructure or CI/CD pipelines. You enjoy building new integrations and making existing systems more reliable and observable, and you're systematic about debugging issues across services and preventing them from recurring. You communicate clearly, contribute to technical discussions, and can explain complex topics to non technical stakeholders. You take ownership beyond your own work and care about the team. You share knowledge, support teammates, and help improve how the team operates. What we offer: Opportunity to join and impact an early-stage climate tech startup with global aspirations as we scale. A mission-driven, fun and caring environment with high drive and ambition. Competitive compensation, including a very attractive employee option program - you’re part of our journey. Access to best in class AI tooling, we think the ceiling on what a small team can do has fundamentally shifted, and we want you to feel that. Remote-first in Europe, with the option of attending an office in Oslo or receiving a co-working pass on demand. Three annual off-sites to connect with the team in exciting & fun places. Flexible, human-first culture. Stipend for setting up your home office. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ A few things to note: Enode is an equal opportunities employer. Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of colour are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles. Our values are integral to the way we work and are embedded into all our hiring processes. You can read more about our values here .

About Dune

Dune is on a mission to make crypto data accessible. We’re a collaborative multi-chain analytics platform used by thousands of developers, analysts, & investors to understand the on-chain world and the frontiers of finance. We’re a team of ~60 employees, working together across Europe and eastern US timezones ️. We believe in our mission, and in building a powerful, open product that allows individuals and communities to do deep research into important ecosystems like Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and many more. 

We’re backed by some of the world's best investors. In February 2022, we announced our Series B funding round led by Coatue and Union Square Ventures, an important milestone that allowed us to double down on our mission. We’re using the funds to educate, reward and empower a new generation of onchain analysts aka Wizards ‍♀️

If you want to have one of the highest impact jobs on the planet, come join our wonderful team of Galaxy brains.

Learn more about us:

Dune's Vision

Values and working at Dune

As a software engineer in Dune focused on Data you will play a key role in ensuring our data platform scales to accommodate an ever-growing volume of blockchain data. This is a role that involves thinking about large scale distributed systems and distributed databases, and is ideal for anyone passionate about those topics.

We are building a data platform that:

  • Can ingest and process petabytes of data

  • Allows third parties to ingest data

  • Facilitates performant SQL queries across datasets

In this role you will:

  • Design and develop distributed systems in a principled way and take part in high impact architectural decisions

  • Engage in stimulating technical challenges in topics such as distributed systems, very large databases, SQL processing, data modelling, or systems performance

  • Assume ownership of components within our blockchain data platform such as data ingestion and decoding

  • Write code mostly in Kotlin and Go with some Java and Rust with a strong emphasis on good design and performance

  • Contribute to the internal developer experience by improving local test setups, integration tests, and incremental deployment processes.

  • Continually improve how we operate the platform, including seeking opportunities to automate incident diagnosis and resolution using AI

  • Work with one of the fastest engineering teams in the industry.

  • Building AI agents for automation into the team.

You might be a great fit for this role if:

  • You are a strong generalist with fundamental computer science knowledge. You use this knowledge to easily adapt to new technologies and scenarios, and to find the right solutions for the problems at hand.

  • You have an understanding of distributed system design, or the drive to learn if you’re a more junior engineer. Our work is as much about understanding and designing systems as it is about coding in a particular language.

  • Have an understanding of blockchain technology and RPC interactions

  • Have experience with datalakes and formats like parquet, delta, iceberg

  • You have great collaboration and communication skills. We work on the principle that the best output emerges from effective team work and constructive discussions.

  • Coding experience in any JVM language, along with a zeal for writing well-designed, testable software


Perks & Benefits

  • A competitive salary and equity package . Both salary and equity is top 25% of companies in the space

  • Our employee equity scheme has world-class employee-friendly terms with a heavily discounted strike price (~90%) and a 10-year exercise window

  • 5 weeks PTO + local public holidays (that can be swapped to suit you)

  • A fully remote-first approach ‍ within a distributed team with flexible working hours; you structure your own day 

  • Say goodbye to meeting overload! We believe in a healthy mix of async and sync work, so you can focus on what truly matters—no more wasted time on endless meetings!

  • Good health is important, so we offer private medical insurance, dental & vision as standard

  • We believe in paid parental leave to help you celebrate this important milestone, transition to your new life, and bond with your new baby. We offer 16 weeks to primary and 6 weeks to secondary caregivers, fully paid. Plus a 2-week part-time phased return at full pay to help you get used to your new (and slightly more complex!) schedule

  • Quarterly offsites in various exciting locations as a company or team to connect, work together and have fun (so far in Tuscany Berlin Austria and Athens ).

  • On top of this each person gets a yearly travel allowance to connect and co-work with someone or a team of people for a few days.

  • An allowance for your at-home setup, to ensure you are happy, comfortable and productive. If you prefer a local co-working space, we’ll pay for your desk.

  • Career growth and learning opportunities

  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We have created a new career path at Canonical for Performance Engineers who bring exceptional clarity to software performance, correctness and efficiency. We are adding these roles to every engineering team at the company. As an open source platform, we have teams that work at every level of the software stack - from the kernel up through server and desktop applications, all the way to the web. We are adding roles with this focus in every engineering team in the company, to act as drivers of performance engineering skills, tools, culture and insights to our entire product range . We have also created a central performance engineering team, where we will drive shared tools, dashboarding capabilities, measurement frameworks, analytical capabilities and skills. We call this career focus ' percorr ' because we have found that the same deep insights that enable sophisticated performance measurement and design also enable teams to improve their harnesses and frameworks for correctness. Understanding not only the application, but the runtime, the compiler, and the system, all the way down to the CPU, gives an engineer the ability to think creatively and with insight about the right things to measure, and the right ways to verify correctness. We have found that performance engineers will often improve the deepest and trickiest areas of our test harnesses, and unblock their teams to test and measure previously 'dark' aspects of their work. We also have teams that work with every major silicon vendor and cloud, with a particular emphasis on performance optimisation of the entire stack for that architecture, CPU family or hypervisor. Our goal is to ensure that Ubuntu users can select whatever platform they want for their workloads and know they have access to the very best performance and efficiency across the entire stack from kernel to codec.   • Demonstrated experience in backend service design defining service boundaries, contracts and data ownership, not only implementing within them

title: Engineering Manager
description: At NetBox Labs , our mission is to make it easier to build and manage complex networks. As a product company, we do that by developing innovative software for network professionals delivered on-premises and in the cloud. We believe in the power of community and collaboration, and we are looking for a hands-on, player-coach Engineering Manager to lead one of our talented teams. These teams build our core software applications including NetBox and NetBox Add-ons, SDKs, and Plugins, and our observability suite including Diode, Diode Agents and SDKs, and Orb. Much of this development is open source and done in collaboration with our community, but also spans source-available and proprietary software. This role reports to the Director of Engineering. In this role you will: Lead a squad of engineers day-to-day while staying hands-on: reviewing code, jumping into design discussions, and occasionally shipping code yourself to unblock the team or model best practices. Drive execution relentlessly — break down ambiguous problems into clear plans, set sprint goals, remove blockers fast, and hold the team accountable to deadlines. Own the software development lifecycle for your team's projects, from planning and design through implementation, testing, and release. Run effective sprint planning, stand-ups, and retros using GitHub and internal tools, helping engineers break work into well-scoped, executable pieces. Champion modern, secure software development practices and keep quality bars high without slowing the team down. Partner closely with product managers to translate customer and community problems into shippable plans, pushing back with data when scope or timelines don't add up. Coach and mentor engineers individually — give direct, timely feedback, help them grow technically, and build a strong bench for future hiring. Foster a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing within the team. Act as a liaison between your team and the broader tech community, supporting open-source contributors and guiding community-facing initiatives where relevant. Report progress transparently to engineering leadership, flagging risks early rather than after they've become problems. Stay close enough to the code and the architecture to make credible calls on technical trade-offs, while trusting your engineers to own the details of implementation. You will work closely with: Director of Engineering to coordinate cross-functional initiatives and ensure your team's work runs smoothly in our commercial products. Product team to understand customer and community problems and turn them into a stellar user experience. Peer engineering managers to plan cross-functional projects, clarify ownership, surface dependencies, and clear blockers together. Qualifications: 2+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager or Team Lead, ideally in a player-coach capacity where you're still writing code or reviewing PRs regularly. A track record of driving projects to completion on tight timelines, with a strong bias toward action and unblocking your team over process for its own sake. Strong technical background sufficient to review designs and code, and earn credibility with senior engineers. Experience with Agile methodologies, DevOps, and CI/CD in a fast-moving environment. Proficiency with GitHub for code management, project tracking, and collaboration. Solid understanding of software security principles and practices. Experience with open-source software development and community engagement is a plus. Excellent, direct communication skills — comfortable giving and receiving fast feedback in a remote, async-first environment. Proven ability to coach engineers and help them grow, while still being the person who rolls up their sleeves when the team needs it. It would be fantastic if you have the following background: Networking industry experience. Familiarity with Python, Django, Go, gRPC, or OpenTelemetry. Knowledge of cloud platforms and services (e.g., AWS, Azure). Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes). Understanding of data privacy regulations and compliance requirements. About NetBox Labs: NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community. NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox. NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital. Our culture and values: We own and solve problems with high attention to detail. Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win. We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly. NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. raw.jobDescription:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

Job Description

We’re seeking a skilled and diligent full-time Software Engineer to join our growing Control Plane Team. You will work as part of the engineering team to:

  • Develop the Tailscale product, contributing to both open source client code and related backend services;
  • Take ownership of the entire product lifecycle, from writing code to product ideation and strategic decision-making;
  • Work closely with UX/UI designers and product managers to shape features.

Because we’re an early-stage and fully remote company, we’re looking for a strongly motivated individual who can help move the product forward at crucial intersections of the technology and organization: in this case, the control plane and the various services it comprises and supports. The ability to think on your feet, collaborate with highly technical teams, and comfort working asynchronously are essential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work as part of a team of engineers to design, build, test, and document core software components.
  • Develop product features in areas that include our control plane, our relay infrastructure, and our identity integrations.
  • Exhibit ownership over the running services that comprise Tailscale’s product by building for observability, participating in incident response, and fielding customer support escalations.
  • Analyze and improve efficiency, scalability, and stability of various system resources.
  • Bring a security-first mindset to both design and implementation.

What We Are Looking For

  • Experience with distributed systems
  • Experience with the Go programming language
  • Experience with one or more SQL databases
  • Familiarity with networking (IP addressing, routing, etc.)
  • Ability to give and process constructive feedback, as well as work independently
  • Flexibility to adjust to the dynamic nature of a startup
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

UK Pay Range

£128,770—£178,540 GBP

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.
  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.

Please be aware that legitimate emails from Tailscale's talent team will only originate from @tailscale.com, @greenhouse.io, and @interviews.modernloop.io email addresses. For more information about protecting yourself from impersonators and scams, please visit https://tailscale.com/scam-awareness.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Add-Ons
description: Why Mozilla ? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. About this team and role: addons.mozilla.org (AMO) is the foundation of the Firefox add-ons ecosystem. It’s a showcase for developers to publish and grow their extensions, and a place of discovery for millions of users who customize Firefox to make it their own. Behind the scenes are the DevHub which enables developers to manage their extensions. To manage the ecosystem there are a series of Reviewer tools and automated moderation systems. As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll bring a passion for crafting resilient systems that accelerate our review and moderation teams to provide a first-class experience for Add-on developers. You’ll work closely with engineers, reviewers, developer support, and Add-ons leadership to turn ideas into polished features, modernize the platform and its architecture, and see your work reach millions of people around the world. What you’ll do: Deliver major features and architectural improvements across the Add-ons stack, including automated moderation pipelines, Reviewer tools, and DevHub. Help establish and maintain engineering standards across areas such as code review, definition of done, production readiness, runbooks, incident response, on-call practices, coding conventions, and infrastructure as code. Create robust observability systems and data-backed insights. Provide peer feedback, share knowledge and help others grow. Build and improve the systems that enable Add-ons engineering to safely develop, deploy, observe, and operate production services. Improve our CI/CD pipelines using declarative, pipeline-as-code approaches that make changes reproducible, testable, and easy to review. Deliver work iteratively using a visible backlog, short feedback cycles, retrospectives, and demonstrations to stakeholders. Write clear technical documentation, including design notes, Architecture Decision Records, runbooks, and incident write-ups. Work effectively in unfamiliar codebases, tracing requests and asynchronous jobs end-to-end to understand failures and identify opportunities for improvement. Collaborate with designers, product managers, QA, and community contributors to deliver end-to-end improvements. Contribute in the open through pull requests, code reviews, and discussions. Work on: Feature development: submission flows, trust and safety signals, DevHub and Reviewer tools modernization. AMO application systems: Work within our Python/Django, MySQL, React/TypeScript, and asynchronous processing systems. Internal developer platforms : Create tools and paved paths that make it easier for teams to ship and operate software safely and consistently. Team Process: Contribute to team ceremonies, execute process improvement, and provide feedback on team effectiveness. Engineering standards : Help make production readiness, testing, recoverability, documentation, and safe deployment part of the normal development lifecycle. Platform reliability: Deployments, monitoring, and incident response. What you’ll bring: Strong hands-on experience building and maintaining production applications with Python/Django. Experience operating and improving production software systems where reliability and safe delivery matter. Strong experience with CI/CD systems and treating pipelines and infrastructure declaratively as code. Experience designing or improving automated testing and deployment workflows, including integration testing and staged or progressive delivery. Strong understanding of observability as an engineering discipline, including metrics, logging, tracing, service-level objectives, and actionable alerting. Experience building or maintaining internal tools or platforms used by other engineering teams, with an understanding that internal systems have users, reliability expectations, roadmaps, and lifecycle considerations. Experience defining or improving engineering practices such as code review standards, operational readiness, runbooks, incident response, on-call expectations, or definitions of done. Ability to read and understand unfamiliar codebases and trace application behavior across frontend, backend, asynchronous jobs, data stores, and infrastructure. Experience debugging complex production issues and turning what you learn into lasting system improvements. Strong technical writing skills, with experience creating useful documentation such as design documents, ADRs, runbooks, and incident reports. Experience working iteratively with a visible backlog, regular stakeholder feedback, and retrospectives that result in concrete improvements. Strong collaboration and communication skills in a distributed team environment. A willingness to share knowledge and mentor peers in operational and reliability practices. Commitment to our values: Welcoming differences Being relationship-minded Practicing responsible participation Having grit Bonus points for: Experience with Google Cloud and operating Kubernetes. Experience with infrastructure-as-code tooling and policy-as-code. Experience establishing SLOs and error-budget-based reliability practices. Experience with chaos engineering, disaster recovery testing, or production readiness reviews. Experience with trust and safety, automated moderation, abuse prevention, or other adversarial systems. Contributions to open source projects What you’ll get: Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute) Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday One-time home office stipend Annual professional development budget Quarterly well-being stipend Considerable paid parental leave Employee referral bonus program Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country) About Mozilla Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online. Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions. We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at hiringaccommodation@mozilla.com to request accommodation. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose. title: Senior Manager, Solution Engineering - DocV
description: Why Socure ? Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day. We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading. About the Role DocV Solution Engineering is part of the Product Engineering organization and plays a critical role in accelerating customer adoption, enabling the field, and improving system reliability. We are seeking a Senior Manager to lead the DocV Solution Engineering team and partner closely with Customer Success, Commercial, Product, and Engineering teams. This role focuses on short-term, high-impact technical work that enables revenue, accelerates rollout of new DocV features, and improves platform stability—while core backend and frontend teams remain focused on long-term product roadmap delivery. What You’ll Do Build and lead a Solution Engineering team embedded within Product Engineering. Partner closely with Customer Success and Commercial teams to unblock implementations and accelerate customer outcomes. Deliver short-term technical initiatives that enable field teams and support active customer engagements. Collaborate directly with customers on complex DocV integrations and deployment challenges. Develop targeted features, prototypes, and integrations that accelerate adoption of new DocV capabilities. Identify and address integration-related technical debt to improve reliability, stability, and operational robustness. Establish a strong feedback loop between customers, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering teams. Collaborate with Backend and Frontend teams to transition validated solutions into the core product roadmap where appropriate. Anticipate recurring customer and field needs and drive scalable, repeatable solutions. What You Bring 8+ years of engineering, solutions engineering, or technical consulting experience. We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold. Position Description: As Chief Technology Officer, you will drive execution for the product and engineering teams and put AI at the core of everything the company builds. You will own Toptal’s full technical architecture and you will build it AI-first—utilizing best practices for agentic engineering. AI is not a workstream inside the engineer team—its core to it. You will create and own the AI architecture and best practices the rest of the company utilizes. You will also own the initiatives that put agents into production. You should know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up, how to engineer best-in-class harnesses, and how to create best practices for agentic engineering that engineering teams adopt to 10x their productivity—without sacrificing quality. Your mindset will be that of a builder and an architect, someone who solves problems in the system itself. No problem will be too large or too small for you to solve yourself. You will set the technical direction and hold the cadenced meetings that turns technical strategy into working, production-ready outcomes. You will be in the design reviews and in the code, not adjacent to them. You will move fast, and you will ensure our engineering team is never the reason an initiative slows down. You are the technical owner of all Toptal’s products. You will collaborate closely with Product to design infrastructure that exposes Toptal’s core business logic through modular interfaces the rest of the business can build on. Alongside a group of hands-on executives, your engineering discipline directly shapes Toptal’s growth, profitability, and operational excellence. You will own resourcing and workforce planning as a doer: scoping the work, sizing the teams, planning headcount against it, defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing it off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about hiring A-players—with a sense of urgency. Then, you lead the team. You will set the standards, develop people against those standards, and know exactly who is meeting those standards. You will be one of Toptal’s foremost experts on AI, and you will stay ahead of a field that never stops moving. You will coach engineers on agentic best practices, show the executive team what is newly possible with the new AI tooling, and push AI into every function at Toptal. This role runs on high-energy execution and attention to detail. You will bring urgency to every part of it and measure yourself on outcomes. We are not looking for someone to oversee this work. We are looking for someone to drive it and get into the details. This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities: The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. One precondition runs through all of it: you conceive the strategy. You will form your own view of where engineering and AI should go, build the case, and bring the CEO a strategy to react to, not a request for direction. AI and agentic engineering Own Toptal’s AI technology strategy and the architecture beneath it: model selection and fine-tuning, harness design, orchestration, retrieval, context engineering, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, evaluation, and cost control, exposed as primitives every team composes against. Deploy agentic engineering at scale against the work that runs this business: matching, vetting, onboarding, delivery, and internal operations. Own the outcomes those agents are accountable for. Make AI quality measurable. Own the evals, the regression suites, and the review loops, so quality here is proven rather than claimed. Rebuild how the platform gets built and operated, raising output per engineer through AI-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Engineers have to want this, not comply with it, and creating that pull is on you. Team, resourcing, and accountability Decide what a team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product. Own resourcing and workforce planning: scope the roadmap into buildable work, plan headcount and sequence, write the specs, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments. Own the bar for the team: assess talent honestly, develop people against the bar, and hold it as the organization grows. Platform and execution Own the architecture end to end, from services and data flows to interfaces and system boundaries, and hold the standards that keep it coherent as it grows. Own throughput, reliability, and the platform layer beneath them, including the AI-dependent paths where latency, drift, and provider outages are real failure modes. Own build-versus-buy, technical debt, secure-by-design architecture, responsible AI, and the engineering and AI cost structure down to inference and token spend. Establish a direct, working rhythm with the CEO. In the first month, expect to: Assess the engineering function honestly, and assess AI maturity with it: what is really in production, what is measured, what is duplicated, and what should be shut down. Assess the team against the bar this role requires, and bring the executive team a strategy no one asked you for. In the first three months, expect to: Be executing your own plan, with a review cadence and clear accountability at every level, and your resourcing plan presented. Stand up the shared AI architecture and evals, and put one agentic workflow into production with a baseline and a measured result. In the first six months, expect to: Show business impact from agents in production in at least two core workflows, with the evidence behind it. Have the leadership team you need, with the bar visibly raised, and throughput and reliability moving on the paths that matter most. In the first year, expect to: Run an engineering organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with the pull on AI now coming from engineering. Have AI leverage embedded in the architecture and the operating model, not living in a portfolio of pilots, and the team you built delivering against plan. Qualifications and Job Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is required, and an advanced degree is strongly preferred. 15+ years of progressive engineering leadership, including significant time as a CTO or VP of Engineering, or as a direct report to one at meaningful scale. Deep, current, hands-on command of modern AI engineering: foundation models, agentic architectures, harness design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation. You have shipped and operated these in production, and you know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up. Agentic systems deployed at scale against real business processes, with measured outcomes on cost, cycle time, quality, or revenue, and a record of retiring what did not work. Rigor about evaluation. You can explain precisely how you knew a model, prompt, or agent change was an improvement, and you can show the evidence. Command of the economics underneath it: model routing, hosted versus self-hosted, inference capacity, latency and cost budgets, and staying portable across providers. Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for. Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, and a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar. Currently hands-on. You read and write code, you can take apart a design document or an eval harness and find the flaw in it, and you command distributed systems, service architecture, data-intensive applications, and cloud infrastructure at scale. Experience scaling and modernizing a large existing codebase without stopping the business. You have replaced load-bearing systems in flight, not only built greenfield. Experience leading a globally distributed, remote team at a technology or hyper-growth company is required. A high-volume, two-sided marketplace or multi-tenant platform is a significant plus. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Speed, ownership, and quality. raw.jobDescription:
SeatGeek believes live events are powerful experiences that unite humans. With our technological savvy and fan-first attitude we’re simplifying and modernizing the ticketing industry.

Reporting to the VP of Engineering, the Director of Engineering will lead the engineering organization responsible for the systems at the core of how teams, venues, and promoters manage tickets and operate their businesses. Hundreds of major live event venues around the globe rely on the SeatGeek platform, including those home to the Dallas Cowboys, Cleveland Cavaliers, Florida Panthers, and Manchester United F.C.

You will set technical direction for this complex, mature platform while helping lead its evolution toward SeatGeek’s next generation of products and architecture. At the same time, you will help change how we build software as we move toward an AI-native engineering organization.

This role requires someone who can move comfortably between technology, product, and the ticketing domain. You will partner closely with Product and Design leadership, Engineering Managers, Senior Engineers, and our clients to turn complicated business problems into clear technical and product direction.

What you'll do

  • Set technical direction across US Ticketing, working with Engineering Managers and Staff+ engineers on architecture, system ownership, modernization, and platform boundaries
  • Lead the evolution of a mature, business-critical platform, balancing client commitments and near-term delivery with long-term reliability, scalability, and modernization
  • Stay close to the technology and contribute directly when useful, whether through code, prototypes, debugging, architecture reviews, technical designs, or documentation
  • Pioneering AI-native engineering by evolving how teams design, build, test, operate, and understand software, and by turning successful experiments into repeatable improvements
  • Partner as a peer with Product and Design leadership to shape strategy, not simply execute a roadmap
  • Develop a deep understanding of our clients and business, distinguish client-specific needs from durable platform opportunities, and participate directly in important client, sales, and implementation conversations when engineering context matters
  • Lead and develop Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders, creating clear ownership and strong leverage through others
  • Build a strong engineering organization by developing leaders, growing Staff+ talent, and evolving team structure as the business changes
  • Create an engineering culture that combines high ownership, healthy technical debate, strong execution, and sustainable performance

What you have

  • Experience leading multiple engineering teams and Engineering Managers in a complex software organization
  • Strong technical judgment and enough architectural depth to work credibly with senior engineers on difficult system and platform decisions
  • A willingness and ability to contribute technically when it is the highest-leverage way to help, including architecture, technical writing, prototyping, debugging, and code
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted software development and a strong point of view on how AI changes engineering practices and the software development lifecycle
  • Experience evolving mature, business-critical systems while continuing to deliver customer value
  • A track record of creating technical strategy from ambiguous product and business problems
  • Experience partnering closely with senior Product and Design leaders and learning complex customer domains quickly
  • Experience developing Engineering Managers and Staff+ engineers and creating leverage through other leaders
  • Strong cross-functional leadership, communication, ownership, and comfort making consequential decisions with incomplete information
  • Experience with ticketing, live events, commerce, payments, reservations, inventory, or similarly complex transactional systems is a plus

Our stack

US Ticketing includes mature systems that have powered some of the world’s largest live events for years alongside newer services and applications. We care much more about your ability to understand complex systems, make sound architectural decisions, lead modernization, and use new tools effectively than experience with any particular language or framework.

This is a deeply technical leadership role. We do not expect the Director to be the primary implementer, but we do expect them to be willing and able to contribute technically when it helps move the team forward. AI is becoming a core part of our engineering process, and this leader will help us rethink how teams build and evolve software in an AI-native development environment.

Perks

  • Equity stake
  • Discretionary annual bonus
  • Flexible work environment, allowing you to work as many days a week in the office as you’d like or 100% remotely
  • A WFH stipend to support your home office setup
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Up to 16 weeks of fully-paid family leave
  • 401(k) matching
  • Student loan matching program
  • Health, vision, dental, and life insurance
  • Up to $25k towards family building, reproductive health services and Gender-affirming care
  • $500 per year for wellness expenses
  • Subscriptions to Headspace (meditation), Headspace Care (therapy), and One Medical
  • $360 per quarter to spend on tickets to live events
  • Annual subscription to Spotify, Apple Music, or Amazon music

The salary range for this role is $236,000-$341,000 USD. This role is equity eligible. In addition, you may receive a discretionary annual bonus based on individual and company performance. Actual compensation packages within that range are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, certifications, and specific location.
